profile_text.body:
Duolingo is a public company, traded under the ticker DUOL, that describes itself as the world's most popular way to learn a language. According to its own site, it offers language learning that is 100 percent free, fun, and science-based, playable online at duolingo.com or through its apps. The company describes the experience as learning by playing a game and states that it is scientifically proven to work.

Its tracked AI product is Duolingo for Schools, listed under Education and Research AI. The product is free and provides AI-driven adaptive assignments for students and teachers. Student accounts for under-13 users are allowed with restrictions: no public profile, leaderboards, forums, or social logins, and non-personalized ads for users under 16. A K-12 data leadership directory notes no signed California Student Data Privacy Agreement.

The company's profile lists CIK 0001562088 and confirms it operates for profit as a public company.
